Contact: privacy@devunivers.com | support@devunivers.com

registerTermsSecScopeBody: Sirvya is operated by DevUnivers in Morocco and designed for global accessibility. This comprehensive legal framework governs your use of Sirvya worldwide. It adheres to Moroccan privacy regulations (Law 09-08 / CNDP) and aligns with international data protection benchmarks including the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and global consumer protection standards.
registerTermsSecDefsBody:
• Platform: Refers to the Sirvya application, its associated web infrastructure, AI services, and systems provided by DevUnivers.
• Company: Refers to DevUnivers, the operating legal entity.
• User: Any individual creating an account on the Platform to track nutrition, workouts, book services, or interact with Coaches/Gyms.
• Coach: An independent fitness professional or personal trainer offering services or advice via the Platform.
• Gym: An independent fitness facility or studio listed on the Platform.
registerTermsSecTosBody:
1.1 Acceptance of Terms
By accessing, creating an account, or using Sirvya, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, you must discontinue use and uninstall the app.

1.2 Eligibility & Age Requirements
Users must be at least 18 years old (or the legal age of majority in their jurisdiction) to independently register. Minors between 13 and 17 may only use the platform under parental/guardian supervision and verifiable consent. Sirvya is strictly not intended for children under 13.

1.3 Account Security & Integrity
You are responsible for safeguarding your credentials. Account sharing, selling, automated scraping, reverse engineering, security tampering, or unauthorized commercial exploitation is strictly prohibited.

1.4 Subscription & Marketplace Terms
While certain core features are currently provided free or in beta, Sirvya reserves the right to introduce optional premium features, subscriptions, or transaction fees with clear prior notice.

1.5 Limitation of Liability
To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, DevUnivers, Sirvya, and their affiliates shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, punitive, or consequential damages resulting from app usage, workout activities, nutritional tracking, or interactions with independent third parties.

1.6 Governing Law & International Users
These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Kingdom of Morocco. If you are an individual consumer residing outside Morocco (such as in the European Union, United Kingdom, United States, or GCC), nothing in these Terms deprives you of the mandatory statutory consumer protections provided by the laws of your country of habitual residence. In case of any concern, we encourage contacting support@devunivers.com for informal amicable resolution.
registerTermsSecPrivacyBody:
2.1 Data Collection & Purpose
We collect personal and health-related fitness data exclusively to provide personalized fitness tracking, coach discovery, and nutrition analytics (name, email, age, height, weight, BMI, meal logs, macros, booking records, and chat communications).

2.2 Health & Biometric Data Consent
Tracking nutrition, calories, body weight, and workout metrics involves health-related data. By using these optional features, you provide your explicit consent for Sirvya to store and process this data to display your diary, calculate calorie targets, and track fitness progress.

2.3 AI Meal Scanning & Microsoft Azure
Optional meal photo analysis transmits stripped image data via secure TLS encryption to Microsoft Azure AI (GPT-4 mini) solely to estimate foods, portions, and macros. Photos are processed ephemerally in memory and are not retained in Sirvya server storage.

2.4 Location & OpenStreetMap Nominatim
When granted permission, device location is accessed to detect your city and display nearby coaches. Reverse geocoding is powered by OpenStreetMap Nominatim under OSM privacy safeguards. Your precise GPS coordinates are never broadcast to other users.

2.5 International & GDPR User Rights
Regardless of your country of residence, you have full control over your personal data:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of your personal data.
• Right to Rectification: Correct or update any inaccurate information.
• Right to Erasure: Request total deletion of your account and linked records.
• Right to Withdraw Consent: Discontinue health/location tracking at any time.
• In-App Deletion: You can permanently delete your account directly inside the app settings under your profile.
For any privacy inquiry, contact privacy@devunivers.com.
registerTermsSecHealthBody:
3.1 NOT A HEALTHCARE PROVIDER
SIRVYA IS NOT A MEDICAL PLATFORM, MEDICAL DEVICE, OR HEALTHCARE PROVIDER. App content, AI estimates, and Coach services are for informational and lifestyle purposes only and must NEVER replace qualified medical diagnosis or professional healthcare advice.

3.2 CRITICAL ALLERGY WARNING
NEITHER SIRVYA, ITS AI IMAGE SCANNER, NOR ITS INGREDIENT DATABASES DETECT OR VERIFY ALLERGENS (such as peanuts, tree nuts, gluten, dairy, shellfish, soy, or eggs). NEVER rely on Sirvya or photo scans if you have food allergies, celiac disease, or medical dietary restrictions. Always check manufacturer labels.

3.3 Assumption of Physical Risk
Physical exercise entails inherent risks of injury. Consult a licensed physician prior to starting any new training or nutrition regimen. You voluntarily assume all physical risks associated with workouts.

3.4 Emergency Services
In the event of a medical emergency, immediately contact your local emergency response services (such as 15/190 in Morocco, 112 in the EU, or 911 in the US).
registerTermsSecOpenSourceBody: Food and nutritional information in Sirvya is powered in part by the Open Food Facts global collaborative database (openfoodfacts.org), made available under the Open Database License (ODbL 1.0) and Database Contents License (DbCL). Open Food Facts is an independent open-data project and does not endorse Sirvya.
registerTermsSecCoachBody:
5.1 Independent Status
Sirvya is a neutral technology platform connecting users with fitness providers. Coaches and Gyms operate as independent businesses and are solely responsible for their sessions, guidance, and qualifications.

5.2 Zero Tolerance for Fraudulent Credentials
Falsification of professional certifications or misrepresentation results in immediate account expulsion and potential legal reporting.
registerTermsSecCommunityBody:
6.1 Community Standards: Zero tolerance for harassment, hate speech, spam, offensive media, or unauthorized commercial solicitation.

6.2 Intellectual Property: Sirvya brand assets, designs, code, and interfaces are the proprietary property of DevUnivers. Users retain ownership of their personal workout content.
registerTermsSecBookingBody:
7.1 Commitment: Automated systems detect and prevent fraudulent bookings.
7.2 Provider Policies: Individual session cancellations are governed by the specific Coach or Gym policy selected at booking.
